title: Here Are the English Lyrics to Karol G’s Ultra-Provocative ‘Matadora’
summary: The NSFW tune marks the second single off of her upcoming set.
contentText:
Karol G is set to release her sixth studio album soon, and to build expectations, she premiered her single “Matadora” on the opening night of her Viajando Por El Mundo Tropitour on July 4 in Chicago.

Related

Meaning “killer” or “stunning,” the provocative and NSFW song is powered by a hard-hitting perreo sound and unapologetic lyrics about owning her sensuality. “Baby, I’m not feeling romantic/ You’ve got me all hot and bothered/ Let’s cut the small talk,” she sings in the opening verse. 

“Matadora” — which debuted No. 3 on the Hot Latin Songs chart dated Aug. 8 — marks the second preview off of her forthcoming sixth studio album, No Me Arrepiento de Sentir Tanto , following the melancholic ballad “Después de Ti” in collaboration with Greg Gonzalez.
